CD08461X1825_0000.title: Chiffre Rouge Chronographe Blue Ultramatte
CD08461X1825_0000.subtitle: Ø 41 MM, Automatic Movement, Gray and Blue Ultramatte Steel, Polished Steel Bumper
CD08461X1825_0000.inspiration:
Launched in 2004, the Chiffre Rouge has made a name for itself as a bold watch with the architectural asymmetry of its round bipartite case, highlighted by the position of its crown at 4 o'clock.
More than twenty years after its creation, the iconic collection bridges tradition and transformation in new pieces featuring hallmark House details chosen for their elegance and couture aesthetic.
characteristics: Case: 41 mm / 1.6 inches in gray ultramatte steel, polished blue steel bumper
Blue ultramatte steel bezel notched between 9 o'clock and 12 o'clock
CD-engraved crown and red chronograph push button at 4 o'clock for stop/reset functions
Blue brass dial with embossed Cannage motif
Polished pink gold-colored hour and minute hands and indices
Blue ultramatte alligator strap with interchangeable system
Gray ultramatte steel folding clasp with comfort-adjustment system
The design is compatible with Chiffre Rouge interchangeable straps for Ø 41 mm
If the standard size Chiffre Rouge strap is not the right fit, we recommend visiting a boutique for a more suitable size
